names.note: Name page 9722 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Иоанн (Калинин, Оленевский), иерей, исп.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and BOTH parenthesised words kept, the surname and the place together being the fullest form the calendar gives — the day line itself gives only «Иоанна». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; a Cyrillic grep for «Калинин» over every `saint.json` returns only `thaddeus-of-tver`, a different surname-bearer in prose, and «Оленевский» returns nothing.

death.note: The day line gives the year inside the entry, after his name: «Свв. Николая (1942) и Иоанна (1951) испп., пресвитеров.» No year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 июля ст. ст. — «Свв. Николая (1942) и Иоанна (1951) испп., пресвитеров.»

attestations.note: The second man of the day's seventh entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. Here the two agree: the line heads both men «испп., пресвитеров» and name page 9722 grades him «иерей, исп.», priest and confessor, so `confessor`, `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are all the source's own words. `new-martyr` was NOT written — he died in 1951 and the calendar calls him a confessor, not a martyr. THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*kalinin*` and `*olenev*` are both empty. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
